verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents API refunds: a /payments/{id}/refunds endpoint with idempotent retries, dedicated refund-a-payment docs pages, and refund issuance through its MCP server. The evidence never shows refunds issued from the Dashboard, and never distinguishes full from partial refund amounts, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: Dashboard refund workflow, documented partial-amount refunds, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds from both the dashboard and the API
